tagline: 潘泰康胶片单反相机，1983 年发布
description: 潘泰康于1983年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度electronically controlled metal focal plane shutter, speeds B, 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/15, 1/30, 1/60, 1/125, 1/250, 1/500, 1/1000, automatic and flash settings。使用35mm with speeds 12 to 3200 ISO。

specs.卡口: Praktica bayonet with EDC (electronic diaphragm control)
specs.快门: electronically controlled metal focal plane shutter, speeds B, 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/15, 1/30, 1/60, 1/125, 1/250, 1/500, 1/1000, automatic and flash settings
specs.取景器: Pentaprism finder, ground glass screen with diagonally split image and microprism focusing aids, LED scale showing exposure times, with over- and under-exposure warning.
specs.英文简介:
===specifications===
* Type: SLR camera body
* Manufacturer: Pentacon, Dresden (DDR, former East Germany)
* Years of production: 1983-1990 
* Film: 35mm with speeds 12 to 3200 ISO
* Lens mount: Praktica bayonet with EDC (electronic diaphragm control)
* Shutter: electronically controlled metal focal plane shutter, speeds B, 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/15, 1/30, 1/60, 1/125, 1/250, 1/500, 1/1000, automatic
